Context: 1. Guidelines for recruitment of casual labour.-

3. Weekly off.One paid weekly off after six days of continuous work. Casual workers in offices having a five-day week may be allowed one day paid weekly off, provided they have worked for a minimum of 40 hours during the week. - OM, dated 4-6-2016.
4. National Holidays.Daily wage is admissible for National Holidays falling on a working day for them.
5. No payment for other days of absence.Except on weekly off days and National holidays, no payment is admissible when duty is not performed.
